published.source: forever-sim's paladin round 70753, 2026-11-03: the November 2 notes' Vengeance 5 stacks and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization on Holy, and A2's race base stats (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s); the DPS report data isn't regenerated yet

summary: Keeps Judgement of Wisdom on the boss for the raid: every attacker with mana gets 59 mana on half its hits.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Judgement of Wisdom at the pull, for the duty. It lasts 40s and the paladin's melee hits refresh it, so one cast lasts the fight. Judge it again only if it drops
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Holy Strike on cooldown, ahead of Judgement and the seal lines
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Unsealed Wrath: with Seal of Righteousness up, once it has stored all 3 copies, Seal of Command, so the next swing spends them all (one Righteousness hit each) and stores a Command copy. Back to Seal of Righteousness once Command has stored all 3, so that swing spends three Seal of Command rolls
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Unsealed Wrath is new with the October 30 hotfix and unverified: the sim lets landed white swings store and spend the copies, and rolls each stored Seal of Command at its own 7 a minute.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
The duty costs 14.7 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (1024.6 against 1039.3, 20,000 iterations, seed 1).

The duty's own Judgement of Wisdom gives the paladin the same mana back as the raid's did, so the cost is the two seals' GCDs and mana and the one judgement that isn't a Judgement of Command or Righteousness.

Seal of Wisdom (rank 3, 200 mana) is up only until the next seal replaces it. Its own 90 mana on a melee hit is assumed to come on half the hits, as Judgement of Wisdom's does: the client says only "a chance".
Only one 2% crit elixir. A second (Mongoose) would add 14.9 DPS.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
